name: ImageMath
label: Image Math
description: Voxel-wise arithmetic between two datasets: subtract, add, multiply, or divide the second dataset from/into this one. Optionally normalize both to unit mean first, so datasets on different intensity scales can be compared. The result replaces this dataset's active array.

parameters.name: second_dataset
parameters.label: Second Dataset
parameters.description: The dataset whose active array is combined with this one

parameters.name: operation
parameters.label: Operation
parameters.description: How the second dataset is combined with this one (this dataset OP second dataset). Divide leaves zeros where the divisor is zero.

parameters.name: normalize_first
parameters.label: Normalize First
parameters.description: Divide each array by its own mean intensity before combining, so datasets on different intensity scales compare directly.

parameters.name: resample_to_match
parameters.label: Resample To Match
parameters.description: If the second dataset has a different shape, stretch it onto this dataset's voxel grid (linear interpolation) before combining. Assumes both cover the same field of view; add the operator to the higher-resolution dataset to keep its detail.
